explanation: W = 1.45 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold (1.4861 GeV). The Delta resonance (~1.23 GeV) is irrelevant: eta production requires enough invariant mass to create m_eta + m_p, so the physical region starts at W >= ~1.486 GeV (table grid begins ~1.4856 GeV). At 1.45 GeV the final state cannot exist; the Fortran integrator would either hang (known risk near threshold) or return silent N/A. No input file generated. Recommend W >= 1.496 GeV for safe eta runs (code's caution zone is ~1.486 GeV).
